dataset.name: FU-GBC gallbladder cancer cohort (2026)
dataset.description: Independent FU-GBC bulk RNA-seq cohort with source-reported survival, primary tumors, adjacent non-cancerous tissue and patient-matched tumor-minus-adjacent expression contrasts.
dataset.cohort_context: The active release contains 135 RNA-profiled primary tumors and 66 matched adjacent non-cancerous tissues. Tumor is the default patient-level analysis population; adjacent tissue is a paired comparator and is not an independent survival observation. The source supplement does not explicitly define survival time zero.

metadata.source_program: Fudan University gallbladder cancer multi-omics cohort
metadata.curation_note: The listed accessions are molecular layers of one FU-GBC cohort and are not independent validation cohorts. One primary-tumor RNA profile is selected per patient before consulting survival.
metadata.endpoint_note: The source supplies Survival (month) and Status but does not explicitly state the time origin. TRACE retains the source-reported survival label and OS API code, but excludes this cohort from hierarchical survival synthesis until time zero is verified.
metadata.redistribution_note: No open redistribution license was identified. TRACE permits local analysis of the active release, disables matrix downloads and does not represent the source supplement or derived matrices as redistributable.

samples.sample_role: One outcome-independent primary-tumor RNA profile per patient; matched adjacent tissue is available only as an explicit comparator

expression.label: FU-GBC source log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The active release contains 15,926 mapped, complete and unique source gene symbols; duplicates are rejected rather than silently aggregated.
expression.scale_note: Values are retained on the source-declared log2(TPM + 1) scale. Primary tumor has selection rank 0; adjacent non-cancerous tissue requires an explicit sample-type comparison.

endpoints.label: Source-reported survival
endpoints.time_origin: Not explicitly specified in the source supplement
endpoints.event_definition: Source Status = dead is event 1; alive is censored
